user_task: How do I create a basic HTML page?
document: Create a file named index.html. Add a doctype, a head with a title, and a body. Put one heading and one paragraph in the body. Save the file and open it in a browser to check the heading.

user_task: How do I start styling pages with CSS?
document: Create a file named site.css. Set the body font and the background color. Link the stylesheet from the head of the page. Reload the browser and confirm the new color.
